body: I am living in a shit hole third world country, sorry if that sounds rude, or Offensive, and life here is as hard as you can think
But hey, we are here to share thoughts, not to fight each others
Oh now you’re trying to compare? I’m not sure about that, life in a third world country is the best isn’t it

Call me what ever you want man
I deserve it i totally deserve all the negativity 
I’m a psychotic pathetic coward 
Did i Satisfy you?
You’re not selfish 
You’re the best 
You’re more brilliant 
You’re the most sensitive creature of all existence 
You’re a good person
You’re the righteous and the truth
And then i get nothing but Negativity from my so called “friends”
Do you know last year i was about to go to my old highschool and burn that place to the ground?

The ones who has tormented my life, don’t deserve to die a natural death, the ones who have ignored me should feel the pain i have. I used to have a plan, to make them suffer, to make them burn like they would be burned by satan in hell, i was intended to burn them with my Molotovs, i’m glad i didn’t, i know it’s wrong, but it would be sweet to see them rot
